Name: Villagers Anime Portrait
Author: Bunnihime
Description:
Original Anime portraits created Bunnerz/ bunnihime (me)
Inspired by Toonyoza's portraits that I had edited awhile back.

Marriage candidates here (toonyoza ver): http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48/?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO INSTALL MODS:
[b]!BACK UP YOUR ORIGINAL FILES BEFORE YOUR DO![/b]
Copy (.xnb) mod Files to Folder \Stardew Valley\Content\[u]Portraits[/u]
or use Mod Manager
Alt designs are available, just replace the old xnb file!
